title: Astounding Speed! The Horsegirl Fast as Light

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BRRRRRINGGG!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I overslept!
And I call myself a Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm almost certainly not going to make it on time.
Even so, as I sprint up in front of the school gates...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... You're a Trainer, aren't you?
Are you running late?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When you are in a position to guide Umamusume...
That simply will not do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl I've never met before suddenly reprimanded me.
However...
choice_data_list: Why are you here at this hour yourself, then?
Why are you here at this hour yourself, then?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. In truth, I am running late as well.
To be precise, I am merely on the verge of being late.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is a reason for my delayed arrival.
Allow me to explain what transpired...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What a catastrophe...! To think that while getting dressed,
my skirt's zipper would refuse to zip up...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, tape is my only option!
As long as nobody notices, there is no shame in it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And so, right now, my skirt is held together with tape.
choice_data_list: You really didn't need to tell me that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was a cool, collected horsegirl... but apparently not.
Just what is with this girl?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to blurt out whatever enters her head without hesitation...
From things awkward to mention, to things that should definitely stay unsaid.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! More importantly, we must hurry.
There is still a way for us to avoid being late right now.
choice_data_list: Wait, that's impossible, right? Even for an Umamusume...
Wait, that's impossible, isn't it? Even for an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's running speed far exceeds that of a normal person.
However, considering the time left before class starts, it's virtually impossible...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Normally, one would not make it.
However, that changes if there is a "straight line" from here to the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We will assume that curves do not exist.
If I run the absolute shortest distance in a near-straight line—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am guaranteed to arrive in time! Here I go!
HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could yell "Are you crazy?!" and stop her, the Umamusume sprinted off.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: GAAAH! Ow, ow, OW!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, she slammed headfirst into the Three Goddesses statue, taking a heavy blow.
She ended up tumbling and rolling straight across the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Word about this excessively straightforward Umamusume, "Calstone Light O,"
had already reached my ears from various sources.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Light O, can I ask you for some advice...?
Truth is, I got into a huge fight with a friend.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I know I messed up, too. But it's hard to just say I'm sorry out of nowhere,
so I want to find a way to patch things up bit by bit, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Understood. You want me to subtly break the ice on your behalf.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We need to talk. She wants to make up with you.
Though she said she finds it difficult to admit she was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: D-Don't tell her EVERYTHING~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, basketball today, is it?
Run towards the hoop, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Right!
Passing to you... Here you go, Light O-san!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is an option, but...
Feinting a pass, I will instead—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Break through with a straight drive!
TAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Charging in a straight line right into the defense...!
Oh dear...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O barreled straight down the center of the opposition without hesitation,
and had the ball stolen from her in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Doubled our score, huh...
What a terrible blowout...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Are you a Trainer from around here?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm Believe.
Um, did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe appeared to be a cautious, deliberate sprinter.
When I asked her about Calstone Light O, she replied—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Light O-san is always charging straight ahead, totally inflexible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's basketball or soccer, she just dribbles in a straight line.
So her movements get read, and she gets shut down immediately...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O may look sharp and composed on the surface,
but she seemed to be quite the peculiar Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Then, on my way home one day.

text_block_list.name: Snatcher
text_block_list.text: Outta the way!! Yoink, thanks for the bag!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, a motorcycle approached from behind and snatched my bag!
I can't believe I just got mugged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scrambled to chase after him, but the road was a complete straightaway.
There was no way on earth I could catch up to a motorcycle here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought all hope was lost—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Are you unharmed?!
Leave this to me—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will apprehend that thief and make him atone for his crimes.
Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are overwhelmingly fast compared to ordinary humans. But a motorcycle
is a different beast entirely. With him speeding off like that, there was no way she could catch up...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAARRRRGGHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her acceleration was smooth. Just as expected of an Umamusume.
However, the real problem began now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no way she can reach a top speed faster than a motorcycle.
She'll inevitably hit her ceiling and get left in the dust...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is where it begins—HAAAAAAAH!
OOOORRRRRAAAAAGHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I witnessed something truly unbelievable.
That Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O—transformed into an arrow faster than the wind itself.
Surpassing the maximum speed an Umamusume could ever output, she—

text_block_list.name: Snatcher
text_block_list.text: WHOOOA, NO FREAKIN' WAYYYY?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw... a light.
A single, brilliant ray of light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unleashing a top speed that outstripped the motorcycle,
that Umamusume planted herself squarely in the thief's path.
